reviews.review_description: Such a great little game, from the unique interactions with the hives and extracting honey from frames, to the management of different honeys to sell to those ever demanding neighbours! It is super fun to relax into the process of harvesting, jarring and selling honey and saving up to upgrade the garden along the way! The game has great potential on top of what is already here to play! Love it!

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for your very kind review, I'm so glad you found it a relaxing experience and enjoyed all the interactions!

reviews.review_description:
Honey & Hives is an enchanting beekeeping simulator that welcomes you with top-notch tutorials, gently guiding you into the beautiful world of hives and honey. Once you’re up and running, the game shines as you mass-produce honey, plant seeds, and link them to bee frames to create new varieties—delighting customers and expanding your apiary.
With new planters to purchase, you can diversify your harvest and enjoy a little bit of everything. While the ultimate goal is helping grandpa with renovations, the beekeeping activities are so satisfying they’ll keep you hooked long after the goal is met.
A solid, cozy title that makes you feel like a true beekeeper—highly recommended for fans of relaxing sims! 🐝✨

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for the kind review, I'm so glad you're enjoying the beekeeping experience!
